channel.title: Topic movers · UN Audience Intelligence Atlas
channel.description: The Topic Explorer's daily movers list: which of the tracked UN-relevant topics are rising or falling in worldwide Wikipedia attention, published figures only. Decision support, not a measure of media coverage or public opinion.

item.title: Topic movers 2026-08-27: Debt relief +464%, Same-sex marriage +183%, Wind power -59%
item.description:
Topic movers, measured through 2026-08-27: attention in the 7 days to that date compared with the prior 30 days.

Rising

  • Debt relief +464% (driven by French Wikipedia)
  • Same-sex marriage +183%
  • International Criminal Court +146%
  • International Court of Justice +118%
  • Internet access +86% (driven by English Wikipedia)

Falling

  • Wind power -59%
  • Heat wave -51%
  • Disarmament -29% (driven by English Wikipedia)
  • Climate change adaptation -24% (driven by English Wikipedia)
  • Drought -22%

181 topics measured in 22 languages; 2 tracked topics could not be measured today (no current data, too little traffic, or quarantined as non-organic) and are excluded rather than scored from stale figures. Velocity is measured from Wikipedia reading patterns per language edition, volume-weighted: what people look up, not what media publish.
